from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Company(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial data for a single company from a 10-Q filing."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="Name of the company as reported in the filing")
    period_end_date: str = Field(description="End date of the reporting period in YYYY-MM format")
    consolidated_net_income_value: float = Field(description="Numeric value of Consolidated Net Income (negative if loss)")
    consolidated_net_income_unit: str = Field(description="Unit of the net income value (e.g., 'millions', 'thousands')")
    total_stockholders_equity_value: float = Field(description="Numeric value of Total Stockholders' Equity")
    total_stockholders_equity_unit: str = Field(description="Unit of the equity value (e.g., 'millions', 'thousands')")
    retained_earnings_value: float = Field(description="Numeric value of Retained Earnings (negative if deficit)")
    retained_earnings_unit: str = Field(description="Unit of the retained earnings value (e.g., 'millions', 'thousands')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[Company]
